async def act(page):
    # Fill the 'From' date field
    from_date = page.get_by_role("group", name="Filter").get_by_role("textbox", name="From *")
    await from_date.fill("07/05/2021")
    
    # Fill the 'To' date field
    to_date = page.get_by_role("group", name="Filter").get_by_role("textbox", name="To *")
    await to_date.fill("05/31/2023")
    
    # Click the 'Show Report' button to generate the report
    show_report_button = page.get_by_role("main").get_by_role("button", name="Show Report")
    await show_report_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the report to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
